name: Sushi Rolls
directions: Cook sushi rice according to package instructions.
Mix rice vinegar, sugar, and salt; fold into cooked rice.
Place nori on bamboo mat and spread rice evenly over it.
Arrange cucumber, avocado, and fish on rice.
Roll tightly using the mat and slice into 6–8 pieces.
Serve immediately with soy sauce.

name: Tonkatsu
directions: Season pork cutlets with salt and pepper.
Dredge cutlets in flour, dip in beaten egg, then coat with panko.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Fry cutlets until golden brown and cooked through, about 4–5 min per side.
Drain on paper towels, slice, and serve with tonkatsu sauce.

name: Ramen
directions: Bring chicken broth to a simmer in a pot.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil to the broth.
Cook ramen noodles separately according to package instructions.
Slice boiled eggs and pork belly.
Divide noodles into bowls and pour hot broth over them.
Top with pork, eggs, and green onions before serving.

name: Okonomiyaki
directions: Mix flour, dashi, and egg to make batter.
Fold in shredded cabbage until well combined.
Heat skillet over medium heat and pour batter onto it.
Lay bacon slices on top and cook until bottom is golden, about 4 min.
Flip and cook the other side until bacon is crispy and batter is cooked through.
Drizzle with okonomiyaki sauce and mayonnaise before serving.

name: Miso Soup
directions: Heat dashi in a pot over medium heat until warm.
Whisk in miso paste until fully dissolved.
Add tofu cubes and wakame, simmer for 2–3 min.
Slice green onions and sprinkle on top.
Serve immediately.

name: Gyudon (Beef Bowl)
directions: Combine soy sauce, mirin, and sugar in a pan over medium heat.
Add sliced onion and cook until soft, about 3–4 min.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 2–3 min.
Divide cooked rice into bowls and top with beef mixture.
Serve hot.

name: Tempura
directions: Beat egg lightly and mix with ice water.
Add flour and stir lightly; do not overmix.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F.
Dip shrimp and vegetables in batter and fry until golden, about 2–3 min.
Drain on paper towels and serve with dipping sauce.

name: Onigiri (Rice Balls)
directions: Wet hands with water and sprinkle lightly with salt.
Take a handful of rice and make an indentation in the center.
Place filling inside and shape rice into a triangle.
Wrap with a strip of nori.
Serve immediately or store wrapped in plastic wrap.

name: Katsu Curry
directions: Fry pork cutlet until golden and cooked through, then slice.
In a saucepan, sauté onion, carrot, and potato until softened.
Add Japanese curry sauce and simmer 10 min.
Serve curry over rice and top with sliced cutlet.

name: Yakitori
directions: Soak bamboo skewers in water for 30 min.
Thread chicken cubes onto skewers.
Mix soy sauce, mirin, and sugar in a small bowl.
Grill skewers over medium heat, brushing with sauce, about 5–7 min per side.
Serve hot.

name: Udon Noodle Soup
directions: Cook udon noodles according to package instructions and drain.
Bring dashi to a simmer and add soy sauce and mirin.
Divide noodles into bowls and pour hot broth over them.
Top with sliced green onions and serve.

name: Tamago Sushi
directions: Beat eggs with sugar and soy sauce.
Cook a thin omelet in a non-stick pan and let cool.
Shape small portions of rice into ovals.
Place a slice of omelet on each rice portion and wrap with nori.
Serve immediately.

name: Takoyaki
directions: Preheat a takoyaki pan and lightly oil each cavity.
Mix flour, egg, and dashi to make batter.
Pour batter into each cavity and add a piece of octopus.
Cook, turning with a skewer, until golden and round, about 6–7 min.
Top with takoyaki sauce and chopped green onions before serving.

name: Matcha Mochi
directions: Mix rice flour, sugar, matcha, and water until smooth.
Microwave mixture for 2–3 min, stir halfway through.
Knead slightly until smooth and let cool.
Divide into small balls and dust with additional matcha or starch.
Serve at room temperature.

name: Nikujaga
directions: Heat a pan over medium heat and cook beef until browned.
Add onions and cook until soft.
Add potatoes, dashi, soy sauce, and sugar.
Simmer until potatoes are tender, about 15 min.
Serve hot as a main dish.

name: Gyoza
directions: Mix ground pork, cabbage, soy sauce, and sesame oil for filling.
Place a small spoonful of filling in the center of each wrapper.
Fold and seal edges with water.
Pan-fry gyoza for 2–3 min, then add 1/4 cup water and cover to steam 3–4 min.
Uncover and cook until bottom is crispy.
Serve with dipping sauce.

name: Karaage (Fried Chicken)
directions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Marinate in soy sauce, sake, and ginger for 20 min.
Coat chicken evenly in potato starch.
Heat oil to 350°F and fry chicken until golden, about 5–6 min.
Drain on paper towels and serve immediately.

name: Chawanmushi
directions: Beat eggs gently and mix with dashi and soy sauce.
Place mushrooms and shrimp into small cups or ramekins.
Pour egg mixture over toppings.
Steam cups in a steamer or pot for 10–12 min until set.
Serve warm.

name: Oyakodon
directions: Slice chicken and onion.
Simmer chicken and onion in soy sauce and mirin for 5–7 min.
Beat eggs lightly and pour over chicken mixture.
Cover and cook until eggs are just set, about 2–3 min.
Serve over cooked rice.

name: Dorayaki
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, and honey until smooth.
Fold in flour to create pancake batter.
Cook small pancakes on a non-stick pan until golden, about 2–3 min per side.
Spread red bean paste between two pancakes to make a sandwich.
Serve at room temperature.
